brief:
Netanyahu is pressing for a fresh military conflict with Iran, Shehab Wire reported, citing CBS coverage of joint Israeli-American contingency planning. Israel and the United States are studying potential strike operations against Iran, the report said, as the Israeli military readies itself and Netanyahu expresses concern over Iranian missile capability reconstruction.

Trump has not yet decided on the matter, according to the account, leaving the direction of potential U.S. involvement unresolved.
dek: Netanyahu is pressing for a fresh military conflict with Iran, Shehab Wire reported, citing CBS coverage of joint Israeli-American contingency planning.
title: Netanyahu pushes for new war with Iran as Trump decision remains unsettled
